name: Public Secure Link Create
description: A guest creates a team-only one-time secure link from the public page. Confidential message is the default; required and Custom fields are directly available while optional type fields use More details. After valid captcha and submission, the guest receives a URL to copy and send through their own channel; the page offers no mail shortcut and creates no draft or automatic delivery flow. Field validation, catalog retry and recoverable server failures keep the input available for retry.
